response.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_remaining_storage FROM site_averages) SELECT a.site_code, a.insurance_status, a.avg_remaining_storage, a.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, a.avg_remaining_storage / m.mean_remaining_storage AS storage_ratio FROM site_averages AS a CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m WHERE m.mean_remaining_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
